commands.name: racer
commands.description: A scrolling dodge race above the prompt — speed climbs as you go, and Claude's real work clears lanes, drops hazards, or hands you a shield (claude-games)
commands.output: racer · click the board, then ↑ ↓ or w/s switch lanes · best 0 · /racer stop closes

commands.name: breakout
commands.description: Breakout above the prompt — paddle, ball and bricks, harder every level, and Claude's real work breaks bricks, armors them, or hands you lives (claude-games)
commands.output: breakout · click the board, then ← → or a/d move, space launches · best 0 · /breakout stop closes

commands.name: dino
commands.description: The dinosaur runner above the prompt — jump cacti, duck birds, faster every second, and Claude's real work clears the way, drops cacti, or shields you (claude-games)
commands.output: dino · click the board, then space/↑ jump, ↓ duck · best 0 · /dino stop closes

commands.name: shooter
commands.description: A side-scrolling shooter above the prompt — waves fly in from the right, and Claude's real work powers your gun, sends extra enemies, or drops a bomb (claude-games)
commands.output: shooter · click the board, then ↑ ↓ move, space fires · best 0 · /shooter stop closes
